target.title: fix(feishu): send card JSON message params as cards
target.body:
Fixes #53486.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu `message(action=send)` and `thread-reply` rendered valid native interactive-card JSON from the plain `message`/`text` parameter as raw text. This also covers the real runtime path where `messages.responsePrefix` is applied before plugin dispatch.

## Why This Change Was Made

Feishu now detects and sanitizes supported native card JSON locally, including v2 `body.elements`, legacy top-level `elements`, wrapped interactive cards, and narrow legacy `div` text elements. Explicit structured `presentation` or `interactive` input remains authoritative over raw JSON text. Malformed JSON, unsupported legacy shapes, ordinary JSON, and card-plus-media requests keep their existing fallback or rejection behavior.

This preserves contributor credit for @martingarramon from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77268 and reporter credit for @ZenoRewn. Blocked lineage PRs #93706 and #94262 were evidence only and were not used as executable sources.

## User Impact

Feishu proactive sends can render valid card JSON as interactive cards again, including when a configured response prefix is present. Structured card controls are no longer discarded when raw JSON text is also supplied.

## Evidence

- 125 focused Feishu tests passed.
- 28 message-action runner tests passed, including the real response-prefix plugin-dispatch path.
- Regression coverage includes v2 cards, true legacy `div` + `lark_md`/`plain_text`, wrapped cards, structured-input precedence, malformed/ordinary JSON fallback, and card-plus-media rejection.
- Extension import-boundary check passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Changelog edit removed per contributor PR policy.
- Maintainer proof override: no live Feishu tenant was used; the changed parser, outbound adapter, action handler, and runtime prefix path are covered directly by focused tests and hosted CI.
